specification.authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
references: §20.4.41, pp. 144-146: 3DSOLID/REGION ACIS body and R2007+ History ID H field
specification.limit: §20.4.41 names the History ID H field but does not specify the complete proprietary ACIS history graph or establish its DXF owner-code mapping.

implementation.change: DRW_ModelerGeometry now retains the encoded history H handle, including raw role code and 64-bit value, plus the exact parser handle-stream bit span and source revision. Reset clears all appended evidence. A private production helper handles exact absence, full H fields and partial/truncated bounds; the opt-in physical probe emits the captured values.
implementation.semanticPolicy: Capture is diagnostic only. It does not translate DWG hard ownership to DXF group 350, validate a recursive target graph, or enable strict output.

coverSource.provenanceLimit: Existing local source; producer is not independently authenticated and no drawing fixture is committed.

frame.readerOutcome: 111/111 published frames; zero entity/object parse failures; zero DataStorage link failures or orphan records.

independentAc1027CrossCheck.provenanceLimit: Original authoring application and production history are not established.
independentAc1027CrossCheck.readerOutcome: 478/481 frames published; three unrelated object parse failures; strict output remains refused.
independentAc1027CrossCheck.priorIndependentOdaResult: The existing p7-ac1027-physical-modeler-acds-sab-oda-byte-join-2026-11-03.json records ODA File Converter 27.1 DXF group 350 with value 0x2e4 and byte-identical SAB payload. This corroborates projected identity/value only, not equivalence of DWG and DXF ownership roles.

parserBoundGeneratedControls: locally authored null code-3 H: exact 8-bit span and zero target
locally authored non-null code-3 H: full 0x2e4 value and exact 24-bit span
locally authored alternate code-5 H: preserved raw role, no guessed semantic mapping
seven-bit partial H boundary: rejected without moving the source cursor
corrected non-null H succeeds after the partial-bound refusal
zero-bit remaining tail is reported as bounded absence, distinct from truncation
validation.profileComparatorTest: ctest --test-dir /private/tmp/libdxfrw-legacy-common-build -R '^libdxfrw_ac1027_acds_source_compare_self_test$' --output-on-failure passed 1/1 in 0.08 seconds; it rejects wrong role and malformed span and accepts corrected retry.
validation.scopeLimit: The generated C++ controls exercise the exact production bounded-H helper used by DRW_ModelerGeometry::parseDwg, while the two source probes exercise complete modeler entity parsing. No full test suite was run.

remaining: Establish a producer-independent normative or native explanation for the code-3 DWG owner role and the ODA DXF group-350 projection.
Resolve and validate the non-null history target 0x2e4, including its frame identity, owner role and recursive dependencies.
Add parser-bound generated truncation/reset/retry controls for the R2007+ History ID handle stream.
Keep strict whole-source conversion refused until source graph closure and the complete 3D output route pass their separate gates.
